analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($385.98) vs SMA5 ($380.47)/SMA20 ($383.20)/SMA50 ($395.42) — trading above SMA5 and SMA20, below SMA50, indicating short-term bullishness and mid-term bearishness.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($382.95)/SMA200 ($364.71) — long-term trend remains strong.
· 52-week position (48.9%) + current price level is historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.9 → 50.2) — continuing sideways movement in the neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (2.1953 → 0.3127) — improving but still in weak convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $383.20) — consolidating around the mid-band, with a band width of 11.11%, indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($370.65) — based on Pivot S1 ($359.10) and SMA100 ($382.95).
· Swing resistance ($386.48) — potential for strengthening short-term upward momentum if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern — absence of clear Higher Low or Lower High patterns, indicating a consolidation phase.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.66) — subdued compared to the 5-day average, reducing conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of directional bias.
analysis.patternNote: 일봉상 5일 및 20일 고가/저가 패턴에서 명확한 추세 전환 신호가 포착되지 않아 횡보 구간으로 판단된다.
